displayDescription: Two acetate plates of an idea's network slide into register, then a lens finds the one new link.
motionEngine: GSAP (local gsap.min.js, single paused timeline at window.__timelines.video)
audioDescription: Silent preview; no music, effects or narration.
limitations: Backlit acetate, translucency and the lens glass are flat SVG approximations made with opacity, gradients and blur. They do not model real light transmission or refraction.
The magnified view is a 1.8x vector copy of the aligned artwork clipped to a circle, not an optical simulation.
This is illustrative artwork, not scans from a real archive.
STYLE.json lists no preview recipes, so the preview shows the core characteristic action.
The technology record could not be written because the selection tool reported a missing project dependency file. The preview uses only browser-native SVG/HTML and the project-supplied gsap.min.js.
